articles.headline: Shandong Taishan handed two-year ban after AFC Champions League Elite no-show
articles.description: Shandong Taishan have been banned from continental competition until the 2027-28 season after a no-show in February.

images.caption: Shandong Taishan have been handed a two-year continental ban by the Asian Football Confederation for their no-show against Ulsan HD in an AFC Champions League Elite tie back in February.

articles.headline: Shandong Taishan: Mass 'physical discomfort' reason behind abrupt AFC Champions League Elite withdrawal
articles.description: Shandong Taishan have provided an explanation behind their abrupt withdrawal from the AFC Champions League Elite.
